title: Run a full lockout cycle to change a machine's cutter
instruction: Lock out the machine, verify it is dead, change the cutter and restore it: slide the isolator handle to OFF and put the padlock in the track behind it, press the green START button and check the run lamp stays off, put the worn cutter in the scrap bin and the new cutter in the tool holder, then put the padlock back on its mark and slide the handle back to ON.
context: Unlike the pending isolate-and-lock tasks (a valve, breaker or isolator locked and that is all, or a lock that gates one removal), this one requires the whole cycle in order: isolate, lock, verify zero energy with a try-start (START pressed, run lamp stays off) before touching the machine, service it, then remove the lock and restore power. Skipping the try-start and restoring before the job is done are common causes of lockout injuries (OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147(d)(6), (e)).
setup: Two arms 61 cm apart on a table; positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x forward, y left, all square to the table. Isolator: two fixed dark steel rails 1 x 3 cm tall, 21 cm long, 5 cm apart, along x at y = -22, from x = 12.5 to 33.5; a loose red ABS handle block 5 x 4 x 4 cm tall, 0.2 kg, between them at x = 17 (ON). Beside the right rail at y = -27.5: a green painted mark 4 x 3 cm at x = 17 (ON) and a red one at x = 29 (OFF). A fixed white mark 5 x 5 cm, 2 mm thick, at (15, -33), with a loose yellow steel padlock block 3 x 3 x 5 cm tall, 0.15 kg, standing on it. Control box: a fixed dark grey steel box 8 x 8 x 5 cm tall at (30, -9); on its top, at its centre, a green plastic START button (2.8 cm diameter, standing 1 cm proud, sprung, 8 mm travel, about 2.4 N at 4 mm) and, 2.5 cm forward and 2.5 cm right of it, a run lamp (1.6 cm glass dome, dark when off, bright green when the machine runs). Tool holder: a fixed grey steel square socket, 4.4 x 4.4 cm inside, 1 cm walls 4 cm tall on a 1 cm base, at (30, 6), holding the worn cutter upright: a dull grey steel cylinder 2.4 cm in diameter, 8 cm tall, 0.15 kg. The new cutter (bright steel, same size) stands on a fixed blue plastic tool tray 10 x 10 x 0.6 cm at (18, 22). A fixed red steel scrap bin, 10 x 10 cm inside, 1 cm walls, 5 cm tall with a 4 mm floor, at (36, 24).
scoring: Automatic, from the parts' poses every step; a part counts only when still and let go (no gripper within 5 cm of its centre). Locked out: handle at OFF (centre within 1.5 cm of x = 29 and 1 cm of y = -22, upright within 15 degrees, underside within 1 cm of the table), then the padlock put in the track while the handle was at OFF and left there (centre within 1.5 cm of y = -22, between x = 14 and 3.5 cm short of the handle's centre, underside within 1 cm of the table, upright within 15 degrees): 0.15. Verified: START pushed down 4 mm or more while locked out (a new lockout must be verified again): 0.15. Worn cutter in the scrap bin (centre inside its walls, underside within 2.6 cm of its floor): 0.2. New cutter seated (centre inside the socket, underside within 1 cm of its floor, upright within 10 degrees): 0.3. Restored, with both cutters placed: padlock back on its mark (centre within 2 cm of (15, -33), underside within 1 cm of the table, upright within 15 degrees) and the handle at ON (as for OFF, at x = 17): 0.2. The first two are kept once earned; the rest are read from the current poses. The whole trial scores 0 if a cutter on the machine (any corner of its bounding box within 1 cm of the holder's footprint, at any height) moves more than 3 mm (so lifted, slid, tipped or twisted) at any time while the machine is not both locked out and verified. Possible scores: 0, 0.15, 0.3, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0.
reset_notes: Slide the handle back to ON, stand the padlock on its mark, the worn cutter in the holder and the new one on the tool tray. The order is judged from the trial video in a real setup.
fidelity: Approximate. The isolator is a handle sliding in a track, not a rotary switch with a hasp; the padlock is a block that blocks the handle's way back. Nothing is energised: the lamp lights if START is pressed with the handle within 3 cm of ON, so the try-start always passes once isolated. No danger tag. The cutters are plain cylinders in a socket with 1 cm clearance a side. Loose parts have rubber-like friction (1.2 static, 1.0 dynamic).
